summary: First iteration full backend + frontend testing of Sanju Animations IT Solutions business manager (freelancer app). Executed 19 pytest backend tests and a Playwright UI script covering login, customers, services, quotations, invoices (with convert-from-quotation and partial+full payments auto-status update), credit purchases (verified NO wallet/balance logic), PDF downloads, reports (all 6 tabs), dashboard, logout, and protected-route redirect. ALL tests passed.

issues: Non-blocking React warnings on some pages: 'destroy is not a function' pageerror + 'useEffect must not return a Promise' warning. Did not break any tested functionality but should be traced (likely from a shared component's useEffect returning an async function - not seen in Customers.jsx itself; possibly a UI lib or Combobox). Low priority.

action_items: Optional: trace and fix the 'destroy is not a function' / 'useEffect async' React warning to keep console clean (does not impact functionality).
critical_code_review_comments: auth.py set_auth_cookies uses secure=True + SameSite=None which is correct for the HTTPS preview but will break local http testing - documented in problem statement, acceptable.
recalc_invoice preserves 'cancelled' status but changes 'draft' -> 'paid' only when due<=0.01; logic looks correct.

reports.monthly uses 'outstanding' derived from invoice_date within month range - this over-restricts outstanding to invoices raised that month rather than all currently open dues; may be intentional for a monthly snapshot but worth confirming with product.
compute_invoice_status returns 'sent' when paid_amount==0 and status was not 'draft' - so an invoice created with status 'draft' stays draft until manual change; expected.
No pagination on list endpoints (to_list(5000/10000)) - fine for MVP but flag for scale.
auth login attempts key uses client.host+email - behind a proxy client.host may be identical for all users. Consider X-Forwarded-For for real deployment.
seed_data_creation: UI test seeded (via authenticated fetch): 1 customer 'TEST_UI_Customer', 1 accepted quotation (total ₹2,124), 1 invoice (converted from quotation, fully paid ₹1,000+₹1,124), 2 credit purchases (20000/₹2,300 and 5,000/₹575). Data left in DB for main-agent inspection.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend regression suite at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py runs with `python -m pytest backend/tests/backend_test.py -n 0` (must pass -n 0 because pytest.ini forces xdist which can reorder tests; test_convert_twice_blocked depends on invoice fixture and was made explicit). All API routes are prefixed with /api. Auth via httpOnly cookies. PDFs served by GET /api/{quotations|invoices}/{id}/pdf. No wallet/balance concept anywhere - verified by scanning customer detail + credit-purchases pages.
